name: Y2K & 90s Retro
tagline: Flash snapshots, chrome, denim and mall-era nostalgia.
description: A nostalgia trip through the late 90s and early 2000s: disposable-camera flash, mall food courts, video rental shelves, roller rinks, arcades, grunge garages and glossy chrome studios. Tinted sunglasses, velour, windbreakers and flannel, finished with authentic film grain.
